title: Seal
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='32' ry='20' fill='#8a9bb5'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='22' ry='12' fill='#d7e2ee'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='22' fill='#9fb0c9'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#c9d6e6'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='34' r='4' fill='#2a1f3d'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='34' r='4' fill='#2a1f3d'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='32.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='32.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3b2d52'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 47 Q50 52 44 52 M50 47 Q50 52 56 52' stroke='#4a6b8a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='47' r='1.2' fill='#6b7f99'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='50' r='1.2' fill='#6b7f99'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='47' r='1.2' fill='#6b7f99'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='50' r='1.2' fill='#6b7f99'/>
  <!-- flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='72' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#7d8faa' transform='rotate(20 20 72)'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='72' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#7d8faa' transform='rotate(-20 80 72)'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M78 84 Q90 82 88 90 Q82 92 78 88 Z' fill='#7d8faa'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M36 46 L26 43 M36 49 L25 49 M36 52 L26 55' stroke='#6b7f99' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 46 L74 43 M64 49 L75 49 M64 52 L74 55' stroke='#6b7f99' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
